anomalies.message: CPU load average is very high relative to the number of cores, indicating potential overutilization.
AI system shows no recent learning cycles, confidence, or generated opportunities, suggesting it may not be functioning as expected.
Trading metrics show no active or profitable trades, indicating potential issues with trading strategies or market conditions.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize the CPU usage to prevent potential system slowdowns or failures.
Review and update AI models to ensure they are learning and generating opportunities effectively.
Evaluate the effectiveness of current trading strategies and consider adjustments or new strategies.

recommendations.action: Immediately investigate the cause of high CPU load and take corrective actions such as load balancing or scaling resources.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability, impacting trading operations and user experience.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough review of the AI system to diagnose why it is not learning or generating opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform competitiveness.

recommendations.action: Analyze current trading strategies and market conditions to identify why there are no active or profitable trades.
recommendations.rationale: Understanding and addressing trading performance issues can improve profitability and user satisfaction.
